title: In Other News: Norwegian Energy Firm Cyberattacks, Supercomputer Hack, New Nightmare Eclipse Exploit
description: This security news roundup covers multiple cybersecurity incidents and developments including cyberattacks on Norwegian energy firms, a supercomputer hack in Japan, malware targeting Common Access Cards on personal computers, and the disclosure of an unpatched Windows 11 lock screen bypass exploit. It also reports on EU cyber sanctions against the pro-Russian group NoName057(16), arrests related to ransomware gangs, and data exposures from compromised vendors and test environments. The incidents vary in impact and scope, with some involving data exposure and others involving attempted intrusions without confirmed data loss.
